storyline.real: Schumacher wins from 16th on the grid, staying out on slicks in the rain; Hill, from eighth, finishes second after a stop-go for pit-lane speeding
storyline.headline: Hill out-thinks the rain and beats Schumacher at Spa

mastery.label: Win with three stops or fewer

eras.briefing: Spa, 1995. A wet-dry qualifying left Hill eighth and Schumacher 16th, and the rain comes and goes. Schumacher leads the championship, 56 points to Hill's 45. Slicks, inters or wets: every lap it's your call. Reconstructed race: no lap timing survives, so the laps are rebuilt to fit the result, the fastest laps and the sourced stops (Jolpica, F1DB, Motor Sport, Wikipedia). The lap-by-lap gaps and running order are synthetic, not history.
